Teach us to remember that Proverbs 2:20-22 opens with a scene marked by wisdom delivers from crooked voices and keeps the feet on a good path. Guard our speech from haste, our work from pride, and our choices from whatever would pull us away from faithful response instead of vague admiration. Amen.
